# TheHumanInTheLoop Marketplace Codex

> Public catalog of Codex plugins created by Mauricio Perera.

## Purpose

This marketplace publishes reusable Codex plugins, skills, workflows, and deterministic validators. It is designed for human-reviewed AI-assisted work.

## Plugin catalog

### linter-seo-geo-2026

- Description: Static analyzer for articles using hybrid SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) pre-publication checks.
- Version: 0.1.0
- Category: Productivity
- Author: Mauricio Perera
- Source: https://github.com/MauricioPerera/thehumanintheloop-marketplace-codex/tree/main/plugins/linter-seo-geo-2026
- Marketplace manifest: https://github.com/MauricioPerera/thehumanintheloop-marketplace-codex/blob/main/.agents/plugins/marketplace.json

## Installation

Clone the repository and register the `.agents/plugins` marketplace directory in Codex. Install a plugin by its marketplace name after registration.

## Source and updates

- Repository: https://github.com/MauricioPerera/thehumanintheloop-marketplace-codex
